what: A photo strip advances one frame every 7 seconds, endlessly. Within each frame it creeps only 4.6% for a little over 3s, whips through the remaining 90% in .5s at the midpoint, then creeps again for a little over 3s (a CSS linear() curve applied to Swiper autoplay delay 0 · speed 7000). The slanted ticks on the thin bar under the strip move to the current frame in turn with .3s ease-in-out. The gap between frames scales with window width (16px at 1440 · 8px at 393), centered loop
ease: linear(0, .046 46%, .5005 50.5%, .955 55%, 1) — the original 41-point curve is in fx.css

options.gap: Gap between slots (px) at 1440 width — proportional to window width, default 16
options.gap-sp: Gap between cells (px) at 393 width — scales with windows 767px and below, default 8
options.center: Set to 0 to turn off centering (on by default)
options.touch: 0 disables drag-to-slide (default on) — flow strip where the original is allowTouchMove: false
options.--fx-slide: Cell width (css variable), default 61vw — if the consuming css sets a cell width, that wins
options.--fx-flow-ease: Curve within one cell (css variable) — set to linear for an even flowing band
options.[data-fx-part=indicator]·[data-fx-part=t: A thin bar with ticks above it (optional) — ticks move between 0 and 92% of the bar width
